heading: INT. NIGHT-SHIFT BAKERY - BACK ROOM - 4 AM

units.text: INT. NIGHT-SHIFT BAKERY - BACK ROOM - 4 AM
Flour dust.
Steel tables.
Racks of dough rising under damp cloths.
A radio plays something soft and unidentifiable.
MR. TEODORICO ABARA-LINDBERG (60s, apron, gentle) kneads.
His assistant, PENELOPE "PENNY" NAKASHIMA-OKOYE (20s, hairnet), oils pans.
At the doorway, a STRANGER in a rain-soaked coat stands with a baguette-shaped package.
Behind her, hiding behind the oven door, is a small, wide-eyed apprentice, QUINCY ADEYEMI-HALVORSEN (12, flour on his nose).
Good morning. Are you the baker?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Everyone here is the baker.
units.name: TEODORICO

units.text: I mean the baker who makes the seeded rye.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Ah. That's Penny.
units.name: TEODORICO

units.text: That's me.
units.name: PENNY

units.text: Then I owe you an apology.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: For what?
units.name: PENNY

units.text: I left a one-star review.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: I remember.
units.name: PENNY

units.text: I was in a mood.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: You called it "a brick with ambitions."
units.name: PENNY

units.text: It was a very good brick.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Teodorico chuckles into the dough.
My name is Perpetua.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Perpetua Chen-Oyelowo. I'm the reviewer.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: We know. You've been in the paper.
units.name: PENNY

units.text: Then you know I'm contractually obliged to review again.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Of course.
units.name: TEODORICO

units.text: I came to taste it. Before I write.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Quincy peeks around the oven.
It's still rising.
units.name: QUINCY

units.text: Then I'll wait.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Penny, make her tea.
units.name: TEODORICO

units.text: I'm making her toast first.
units.name: PENNY

units.text: She slides a loaf from the rack and slices it.
Perpetua sits on an overturned crate.
Quincy tiptoes to sit beside her.
The radio hums.
Nobody, for a while, says anything.
